statusReason: Current gates prove checked-in OpenAPI/AsyncAPI structure, API-client operationId parity, Kotlin controller source-to-OpenAPI path/method parity, core-banking ledger command, inquiry, and case workflow subset DTO schema parity, payment-service, notification-service, and reporting-service DTO schema parity, event schema references, runtime envelope fixture/schema validation, and selected source envelope markers. Full core-banking springdoc/Jackson DTO schema generation remains a PLAN-required gap.

generatedDtoDiffGate.note: Kotlin controller source-to-OpenAPI path/method diffing is wired, core-banking ledger command, inquiry, and case workflow subsets plus payment-service, notification-service, and reporting-service DTO schemas are generated from Kotlin data classes, and core-banking still needs full springdoc/Jackson DTO schema parity.

runtimeEventValidationGate.note: Script is wired and validates synthetic runtime envelope fixtures, JSON Schemas, Kafka header/body consistency, and producer ack/source markers. Full live broker producer/consumer coverage still depends on the service integration tests.

sourceInspection.note: Payment publisher source builds envelope headers and payload metadata before Kafka send; this is source inspection, not a generated runtime schema gate.
Reporting publisher source builds envelope headers and payload metadata before Kafka send; this is source inspection, not a generated runtime schema gate.
Notification consumer source rejects missing envelope metadata and non-synthetic events; this is source inspection, not a cross-service runtime contract validation gate.
Core banking persists durable synthetic outbox records; full Kafka envelope runtime validation is still a PLAN-required gap.

overclaimGuards.details: README and contract evidence distinguish core-banking ledger command, inquiry, and case workflow subsets plus payment-service, notification-service, and reporting-service DTO schema parity from remaining full core-banking springdoc/Jackson DTO schema generation.
Evidence distinguishes the wired fixture/schema/source-marker runtime event gate from full live broker producer/consumer integration coverage.
